newsitem.title: USA: 50-OFF Stores says creditors back plan.
newsitem.headline: 50-OFF Stores says creditors back plan.

text.p: 50-OFF Stores Inc on Friday said its unsecured creditors expressed unamimous support for its reorganization plan.

The creditors stated their support at a hearing on Thursday during which Bankruptcy Court Judge Lief Clark approved the company's disclosure statement under the plan, it said. Clark set June 3 as the confirmation hearing date for the plan

50-OFF, which filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in October, said other creditors such as MetLife Capital Corp and General Electric Capital Corp have also expressed their backing for the plan.
Metlife Capital is an impaired, secured creditor, while GECC, a unit of General Electric Co, currently provides debtor-in-possession financing, for the company, it said.
GECC had expressed interest in providing senior secured exit financing required by the plan, it said.
